# function: iam_role_template

Builds the ARN for `iam` `role-template`:

```
arn:${Partition}:iam::aws:role-template/${AWSServicePrincipal}/${RoleTemplateName}:${RoleTemplateMajorVersion}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:iam::aws:role-template/aws-service-principal/role-template-name:role-template-major-version
output "iam_role_template" {
  value = provider::arn::iam_role_template("aws-service-principal", "role-template-name", "role-template-major-version")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
iam_role_template(aws_service_principal string, role_template_name string, role_template_major_version string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `aws_service_principal` (String) Value for `${AWSServicePrincipal}` in the ARN template.
1. `role_template_name` (String) Value for `${RoleTemplateName}` in the ARN template.
1. `role_template_major_version` (String) Value for `${RoleTemplateMajorVersion}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
